pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit irregular polygonal geometries with moderately rounded vertices. Pixel gradients at edges are soft rather than sharp, with spatial area of patches decreasing in size toward the hindquarters and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-colored negative space forms a continuous, interconnected lattice. Junction nodes predominantly feature tri-point intersections. Pixel thickness of the pathways remains relatively consistent across the mid-flank, showing high topological continuity.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the dorsal neck ridge presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D profile against the background, consistent with short, stiff hair growth.
